paragraphs: R' Assi ben Matya, Yalkut, Pinchas, remez 776.
R' Yehoshua ben Matya, Eduyot, chapter 2, mishnah 5.
R' Yochanan ben Matya, Bava Metzia, chapter 7, mishnah 1.[^1]

notes.text: תשעו totals 776 arithmetically, without modern numbering verification. Yalkut remains unexpanded; ב״מ is contextual Bava Metzia in a Mishnah citation. 2m 5/7m 1 remain explicit, without new primary checks. Matya is conventional vocalization, not an additional printed Mattai variant. Three ben-Matya attestations do not identify their fathers with one another; all three personal-title abbreviations remain R'.
